test_objective: Check that one cannot query the temporal evolution of entities when called with faulty format or options query params
keywords: Query The Temporal Evolution of An Entity With Faulty Format Or Options Query Params

test_cases.name: 021_20_01 QueryWithInvalidFormat
test_cases.doc: Check that one cannot query with an invalid format query param
test_cases.template: Query The Temporal Evolution of An Entity With Faulty Format Or Options Query Params
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities'
        method set to 'GET'
        Query Temporal Representation of Entities and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to '${types}' and
    Query Parameter: options set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: format set to 'invalidFormat' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://easy-global-market.github.io/ngsild-api-data-models/ngsildTestSuite/ngsildTestSuiteV1.8-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: timerel set to 'after' and
    Query Parameter: timeAt set to '2020-01-01T12:03:00Z'
}
